compatibility.packageFootprint: playwright test/dev package plus separately installed Chromium binary and OS dependencies
compatibility.browserInstallation: Explicit playwright install chromium step required; package installation alone must not silently govern browser download.
compatibility.windowsOwnerHost: Supported candidate; owner must validate installed Node and Chromium prerequisites on the Windows host.
compatibility.ci: Requires browser cache/install and secret injection; portable artifacts must redact headers/cookies.
compatibility.cloudflareAccessHeaders: Supported through browser-context extra HTTP headers; values must come from environment and never evidence.
compatibility.screenshotsAndEvidence: Supported; screenshots, traces, and network evidence require sanitization.
compatibility.readOnlyEnforcement: Harness contract and request interception must reject non-GET/HEAD and deployment mutation; Playwright does not enforce read-only behavior by itself.
